title: The iPhone's cannot-start screen offers Delete all my data and Disconnect, as the web's crash screen does (the iPhone half of H123)
evidence: Decided 2026-11-26 (Brad, docs/decisions-for-brad.md): a fallback screen keeps deleting your data within reach. The web has it (US-11 AC14). The iPhone's ios/HealthRoadmap/App/HealthRoadmapApp.swift:26 shows ContentUnavailableView 'The app could not start' with the error's own text and no action. To do after App Store review closes: the same one sentence, with the existing Delete all my data and Disconnect buttons over their existing confirms, reached without the views that failed to start.
